description: This file is a PHP source code defining a controller class 'Forgotten' for the 'account' namespace within the OpenCart framework. It manages various account-related functionalities such as handling forgotten passwords, resetting passwords, and related confirmation workflows.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class handling password forgotten and reset functionalities in the OpenCart's account namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the forgotten password form, redirecting logged-in users to their account page.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes the confirmation of a password reset, validating tokens, and returning JSON responses for success or errors.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles password reset requests; validates tokens, updates passwords, and manages redirections upon success.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Handles the password change process, including validation, update, and redirection workflows.
